name: Portfolio Blog — Production Analytics
description: Production-only evlog telemetry from the portfolio blog Cloudflare Worker: audience, engagement, newsletter funnel and SSR health.

pages.name: Audience
pages.description: Page views, sessions, content and traffic sources from the client beacon in the production blog.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT uniqueCount(sessionId) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) / uniqueCount(sessionId) AS 'Views per session' FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET locale SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT count(*) AS Views FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' AND pageType = 'post' FACET contentKey, locale SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) AS Entries FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' AND isEntry IS TRUE FACET pageType, contentKey SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET referrerSource SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' AND campaignSource IS NOT NULL FACET campaignSource SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET country SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET deviceType SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET theme SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) AS Views FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_view' FACET browserLanguage, locale SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

pages.name: Engagement
pages.description: Time on page, scroll depth, language switches, search usage and outbound clicks.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_engaged' AND pageType = 'post' FACET engagedBucket SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_engaged' AND pageType = 'post' FACET scrollBucket SINCE 7 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_engaged' AND pageType = 'post' FACET contentKey, scrollBucket SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 40

SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE scrollBucket = 'p100') AS 'Read completion %', count(*) AS Sessions FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_engaged' AND pageType = 'post' FACET contentKey SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

SELECT average(activeSeconds) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'page_engaged' AND pageType = 'post' FACET contentKey SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'language_switched' FACET locale, targetLocale SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'search_used' FACET resultsBucket SINCE 7 days ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'outbound_clicked' FACET targetSource SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20

pages.name: Newsletter
pages.description: Subscription funnel, confirmation, preference changes and failures from server-side newsletter events.

widgets.title: Subscribe requests by result and locale

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested' FACET result, locale SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Pending to confirmed funnel by language

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested' AND result = 'pending') AS 'Pending', filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_confirmed' AND result = 'confirmed') AS 'Confirmed', filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_confirmed' AND result = 'confirmed') * 100 / filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested' AND result = 'pending') AS 'Conversion %' FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName IN ('newsletter_subscribe_requested', 'newsletter_confirmed') FACET if(eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested', locale, communicationLocale) AS 'language' SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested' AND result = 'pending') AS 'Pending', filter(count(*), WHERE eventName = 'newsletter_confirmed' AND result = 'confirmed') AS 'Confirmed' FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName IN ('newsletter_subscribe_requested', 'newsletter_confirmed') SINCE 30 days ago TIMESERIES 1 day
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_subscribe_requested' FACET source SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_confirmed' AND result = 'confirmed' FACET communicationLocale SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_preferences_changed' AND result = 'changed' FACET enabledLanguages SINCE 30 days ago

widgets.title: Preference changes by action, channel and result

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_preferences_changed' FACET action, channel, result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 30
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'newsletter_unsubscribed' FACET communicationLocale, channel SINCE 30 days ago

SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName LIKE 'newsletter_%' AND result NOT IN ('pending', 'confirmed', 'already_confirmed', 'changed', 'unchanged') FACET eventName, result SINCE 30 days ago LIMIT 30

pages.name: Health
pages.description: SSR request health for non-prerendered routes plus ingest freshness.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' SINCE 15 minutes ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' AND status >= 500 SINCE 1 hour ago

widgets.title: Rejected or failed events in last 24 hours

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND outcome IN ('rejected', 'error') SINCE 1 day ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' FACET route, status SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 30

SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE status >= 500) * 100 / count(*) AS 'Error rate %' FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES AUTO

SELECT percentile(durationMs, 95) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' FACET route SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 20
SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND eventName = 'http_request_completed' FACET route SINCE 7 days ago TIMESERIES AUTO

widgets.title: Rejected and failed outcomes by event

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log_blog WHERE `service.name` = 'portfolio-blog' AND blogEnvironment = 'production' AND outcome IN ('rejected', 'error') FACET eventName, outcome SINCE 7 days ago LIMIT 30
